email.description:

budget_micros.description: The month's budget: no call starts that could take spend and reservations past it.

reserved_micros.description: The bounds of the calls still running.

campaign_id.description: The campaign, when grouped by campaign, step or variant.

oneOf.description: The day, when grouped by day.

oneOf.description: How far the rollup had counted when these were read; `null` before its first run.

content_id.description: Inline Content-ID, when supplied by received MIME.

download_url.description: Bearer download link, valid for five minutes.

filename.description: Suggested download name; never a path in storage.

AttemptObject.description: One submission effort of a message.

oneOf.description: Why it ended as it did; null while it runs. New values may be added.

diagnostic.description: The provider's words, bounded and redacted.

cookie with this answer.

CampaignLastError.description: What stops a campaign from sending.

code.description: `no_sender` or `invalid`. New codes may be added.

CampaignObject.description: A campaign as the API shows it.

oneOf.description:
Where the campaign's people are now and when its next email may go, counted whenever one
campaign is answered (retrieved, created, updated, started, paused, or archived by a
deletion); `null` in a list. Like `stats`, it is not part of `version`.

steps.description: The steps in order, with their variants (a list leaves out the variants' bodies).

version.description: The version an update's `If-Match` names.

value.description:

100 values for `in`, one value of the field's type otherwise (an RFC 3339 instant for
`created_at`).

ConnectionObject.description: A connection as the API shows it.

oneOf.description: Present when the browser must give consent first.

paused.description: The person's pause: sending stops, conversations wait.

provider.description: The provider of the account; new values may be added.

oneOf.description: When campaign mail may be submitted, in `timezone`.

status.description:

timezone.description: The IANA time zone of the send window.

transport.description: What it submits over: SMTP, or the Gmail API or Microsoft Graph (`api`).

warmup_stage.description: The warm-up stage; null when not warming.

oneOf.description: A relay's or the managed MTA's provider webhook.

ConsentAnswer.description:

cookie of this answer.

bounced.description: Messages that could not reach their recipient for good.

opened.description: Messages with at least one human open.

steps.description: The steps in order, at most 50, holding at most 1.5 MiB of names, prompts and templates.

return_to.description: Google and Microsoft: the dashboard path the browser returns to after the consent.

the Unix epoch. An update sent with it in `If-Match` applies only to this version, so a
replaced list of event types never undoes a change made since it was read. A failure or

skipped.description: The people that were not enrolled, and why.

at each step, and when the campaign's next email may go.

completed.description: Enrollments that went through the campaign's last step.

failed.description: Enrollments that ended because a step could not be sent.

replied.description: Enrollments that ended because the person replied.

Every step of the campaign, in order, with its live enrollments (`active` or `paused`):
those whose email from this step is due or on its way. A live enrollment whose step was
removed counts in its status but at no step, until the next pass completes it.

stopped.description:
Enrollments stopped by a person, a stop rule, a suppression or a sender that left the
pool.

answer is `unknown`. In a test-mode workspace only the syntax is checked, as its sender does:
its mail never leaves the fake transport. SMTP checks share a 15-second budget; use batches
of at most eight addresses to avoid skipping addresses when that budget expires.
